source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    anchors = []
    interior = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            color = grid[r][c]
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            if any(y in (0,h-1) or x in (0,w-1) for y,x in comp):
                anchors.append(comp)
            else:
                interior.extend(comp)
    if not interior:
        return out
    ink = grid[interior[0][0]][interior[0][1]]
    for comp in anchors:
        left = any(x == 0 for y,x in comp)
        right = any(x == w-1 for y,x in comp)
        top = any(y == 0 for y,x in comp)
        bottom = any(y == h-1 for y,x in comp)
        if left or right:
            y = min(y for y,x in comp if (x == 0 if left else x == w-1))
            x, dx = (0, 1) if left else (w-1, -1)
            while 0 <= x+dx < w:
                x += dx
                if grid[y][x] != bg:
                    if (y,x) not in {p for a in anchors for p in a}:
                        out[y][x] = 4
                    break
                out[y][x] = ink
        elif top or bottom:
            x = min(x for y,x in comp if (y == 0 if top else y == h-1))
            y, dy = (0, 1) if top else (h-1, -1)
            while 0 <= y+dy < h:
                y += dy
                if grid[y][x] != bg:
                    if (y,x) not in {p for a in anchors for p in a}:
                        out[y][x] = 4
                    break
                out[y][x] = ink
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-ca310eda.py'

source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    all_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = all_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    anchor_color = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ink = counts.most_common()[-1][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != anchor_color or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==anchor_color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            left=any(x==0 for y,x in comp); right=any(x==w-1 for y,x in comp)
            top=any(y==0 for y,x in comp); bottom=any(y==h-1 for y,x in comp)
            if left or right:
                y=min(y for y,x in comp if (x==0 if left else x==w-1))
                x,dx=(0,1) if left else (w-1,-1)
                while 0<=x+dx<w:
                    x+=dx
                    if grid[y][x]!=bg:
                        if grid[y][x]!=anchor_color: out[y][x]=4
                        break
                    out[y][x]=ink
            elif top or bottom:
                x=min(x for y,x in comp if (y==0 if top else y==h-1))
                y,dy=(0,1) if top else (h-1,-1)
                while 0<=y+dy<h:
                    y+=dy
                    if grid[y][x]!=bg:
                        if grid[y][x]!=anchor_color: out[y][x]=4
                        break
                    out[y][x]=ink
    return out
'''

source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    totals=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=totals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    anchor=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ink=counts.most_common()[-1][0]
    targets=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==ink]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=anchor or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==anchor:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if not any(y in (0,h-1) or x in (0,w-1) for y,x in comp): continue
            minr,maxr=min(y for y,x in comp),max(y for y,x in comp)
            minc,maxc=min(x for y,x in comp),max(x for y,x in comp)
            orient='h' if maxc-minc>maxr-minr else 'v'
            if maxc==minc and maxr==minr:
                orient='v'
            comps.append((comp,orient,minr,maxr,minc,maxc))
    if not comps or not targets: return out
    orient=comps[0][1]
    same=[item for item in comps if item[1]==orient]
    # Locate the boundary bar nearest the colored target pattern and transfer its offsets to all bars.
    def distance(item):
        _,_,r0,r1,c0,c1=item
        lo,hi=(r0,r1) if orient=='v' else (c0,c1)
        return sum(lo-t if t<lo else t-hi if t>hi else 0 for r,c in targets for t in [r if orient=='v' else c])
    ref=min(same,key=distance)
    _,_,r0,r1,c0,c1=ref
    start=r0 if orient=='v' else c0
    offsets=sorted(set((r if orient=='v' else c)-start for r,c in targets))
    for comp,ori,r0,r1,c0,c1 in same:
        cells=set(comp)
        for off in offsets:
            if ori=='v':
                y=r0+off
                if not any(yy==y for yy,xx in cells): continue
                if any(x==0 for yy,x in cells): x,dx=0,1
                elif any(x==w-1 for yy,x in cells): x,dx=w-1,-1
                else: continue
                while 0<=x+dx<w:
                    x+=dx
                    if grid[y][x]!=bg:
                        if grid[y][x]!=anchor: out[y][x]=4
                        break
                    out[y][x]=ink
            else:
                x=c0+off
                if not any(xx==x for yy,xx in cells): continue
                if any(y==0 for y,x0 in cells): y,dy=0,1
                elif any(y==h-1 for y,x0 in cells): y,dy=h-1,-1
                else: continue
                while 0<=y+dy<h:
                    y+=dy
                    if grid[y][x]!=bg:
                        if grid[y][x]!=anchor: out[y][x]=4
                        break
                    out[y][x]=ink
    return out
'''
